name: debias_benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to measure and compare biases present in language models by presenting prompts tied to demographic attributes and evaluating model outputs for biased or stereotypical associations. It provides labeled instances to quantify model behavior across different sensitive attributes and contexts. The benchmark is intended to assess mitigation methods and track progress on fairness-related metrics.
reputation: A niche fairness-focused dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing usage in model debiasing research.
